user.title: Set up My Music Library
user.description: Enter the URL of your Music Assistant server ({ma_url_hint}) and a long-lived API token ({token_hint}).

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Music Assistant
reauth_confirm.description: My Music Library connects to Music Assistant directly (since version 4). Enter the server URL and a long-lived API token — create one in Music Assistant under Settings → your user → API tokens. This step also shows up when the stored token was revoked.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Music Assistant server
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed — check your API token
error.invalid_server_version: This Music Assistant server version is not compatible
error.invalid_url: Invalid URL — must start with http:// or https://

abort.already_configured: My Music Library is already configured
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed

init.title: Player settings
init.description: Select players to hide from the device picker. You can also type a wildcard pattern (e.g. `media_player.browser_mod_*`) and press Enter to exclude all matching players.

data_description.debug_mode: When enabled, detailed logs appear in HA logs (filter: my_music_library) and in the browser console (F12). When disabled, the level set by `logger:` in configuration.yaml applies (HA default: warning). Disable after debugging.

confirm.title: Give the original IDs to My Music Library

data.disable_official: Also disable the official integration's entities

abort.no_duplicates: No duplicate left: nothing to rename.

missing_players.title: Music Assistant players that no longer exist

confirm.title: Delete the media players of vanished players
confirm.description:
Music Assistant no longer knows these players, but their media players are still in Home Assistant (unavailable):

{players}

This usually happens when a device comes back under another identifier: Music Assistant then sees a new player (for Squeezelite, a different MAC address — set a fixed MAC address in the player's settings to avoid it), or for browser web players.

Tick the media players to delete. Untick a speaker that is only switched off: it will come back by itself when it reconnects.

abort.no_missing_players: Every player is back: nothing to delete.
abort.not_connected: My Music Library is not connected to Music Assistant.

play_media.name: Play media
play_media.description: Plays a Music Assistant item (URI, URL or name) on a My Music Library player.

media_id.name: Media
media_id.description: URI of a Music Assistant item (e.g. library://playlist/16), a stream URL, or a name to look up.

enqueue.name: Enqueue
enqueue.description: How to add the media to the queue. Default: play now.

radio_mode.name: Radio mode
radio_mode.description: Keep playing similar tracks once the queue is finished.

transfer_queue.name: Transfer queue
transfer_queue.description: Moves what a My Music Library player is playing (same track, same position) to one or more other players. With several targets, the first one leads a group of them all; the source stops.

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: Players that take over the music.
